procedure: Check every IC pin 1, diode/capacitor polarity, U3 exposed-pad process, connector joints and jumper orientation against drawings.
initial_acceptance_target: No bridges, lifted pins, reversed parts or solder debris. All selectors and JP1/JP2 initially open.

procedure: Verify J1 positive→F1→Q1 drain; Q1 source→VIN_PROT; grounds; CAN H/L connector continuity; each port's power/signal separation.
initial_acceptance_target: Match schematic. Rails must not show a persistent near-short to ground after capacitors charge from the meter. Resistance values alone do not prove correct assembly.

procedure: Set 12 V, initially 100 mA limit, no sensors/CAN/debug power injection. Apply J1 power and observe current and rail rise.
initial_acceptance_target: If current limit persists, power off and investigate; do not simply increase it. A correctly unconfigured board is expected to be well below the conservative 150 mA logic budget.

procedure: Measure TP2 VIN_PROT, TP3 V5_INTERNAL, TP4 3V3 relative to TP1 GND.
initial_acceptance_target: At room temperature, nominal about input minus small loss, 5.023 V, and 3.3 V. Initial DC targets 4.922–5.176 V internal 5 V, 3.201–3.399 V logic. Confirm startup has no damaging overshoot.

procedure: Measure TP5 SENSOR_5V and TP6 SENSOR_VBAT with unconfigured firmware.
initial_acceptance_target: Enables low, rails off. Allow bleed resistors to discharge capacitors; a high-impedance meter may show leakage, so repeat with a modest test load.

procedure: Identify STM32F042K6, program supplied image, verify flash, read UART INFO.
initial_acceptance_target: Correct image and identity; configured=0 until explicit SET; no unexpected reset loop.

procedure: Observe a buffered timing output or CAN bit timing without loading the crystal directly; verify oscillator startup with a suitable low-capacitance method.
initial_acceptance_target: CAN 1 Mbit/s, stable startup over input/temperature. Characterize crystal drive ≤100 µW and frequency error; adjust R20/load capacitors only after analysis.

procedure: Provision unique ID, first rails=0, then deliberately enable one rail at a time.
initial_acceptance_target: Correct rail responds, other remains off; UART/CAN state agrees with commanded enables.

procedure: Electronic loads at 0, 50, 150, 300 mA on each rail, then both at 300 mA. Test J4–J7 individually and distributed loads.
initial_acceptance_target: Regulated port 5 V target 4.75–5.25 V steady at declared conditions; document battery drop. Logic remains healthy. Record connector and switch temperatures.

procedure: Repeat loads at 6, 7, 9, 12, 14.4 and 18 V input; sweep down/up slowly through reset region.
initial_acceptance_target: No CAN lockup or spurious rail enable. Establish actual 5 V dropout and restart limits. Do not claim 6 V full-load regulation until measured.

procedure: Scope internal/port 5 V and 3V3 for 0↔300 mA and mixed-rail steps; include real cable inductance.
initial_acceptance_target: Determine transient envelope and settling. A first-order estimate predicts about 0.10 V transient excursion; the ±5% steady target is not a guaranteed transient rating.

procedure: Increase each electronic load beyond 300 mA while monitoring current, voltage, fault and enables.
initial_acceptance_target: Approximate 5 V limit 394–506 mA; battery limit 428–600 mA only where VS−OUT≥2.5 V. Confirm hardware latch-off and no automatic cycling.

procedure: Use a controlled low-inductance short fixture on each rail, one at a time; capture current and time. Remove short, wait ≥100 ms, explicitly clear.
initial_acceptance_target: Battery nominal hardware delay about 11 ms; firmware may shut down earlier on measured output loss; 5 V overload deglitch specified 5–10 ms. Logic/CAN should remain operational. Verify a persistent short cannot be enabled indefinitely through software recovery.

procedure: Enable all intended real sensors together at 6, 12 and 18 V where sensors permit. Include maximum cable/capacitance.
initial_acceptance_target: No nuisance latch; current and startup delay acceptable. Large capacitive loads may fail despite acceptable steady current.

procedure: Use a current-limited adjustable signal source with common ground; ramp each channel up/down in both threshold modes at 6, 12, 18 V board input.
initial_acceptance_target: Logic: definite LOW at 0.8 V, HIGH at 2.4 V. Industrial: LOW at 4 V, HIGH at 7 V. Record actual hysteresis. Repeat at temperature endpoints.

procedure: Emulate NPN/PNP with off leakage up to 0.5 mA, ON residual voltage at intended bound, and actual sensor cable. Test 3.3 V open-drain with 50 µA off leakage.
initial_acceptance_target: Correct released/asserted states, all channel combinations, no cross-channel toggles. Check low-battery sensor behavior separately.

procedure: Apply 49 µs glitches, then valid transitions at random sample phases; vary debounce 1, 2, 10, 100 ms.
initial_acceptance_target: Glitches rejected for characterized conditions; edge count and state follow intended debounce. Measure latency, do not infer high-speed encoder support.

procedure: Connect a correctly terminated bench bus with another active node to provide ACK. Inspect H/L waveforms, errors and packet timing; then test roboRIO.
initial_acceptance_target: Correct ID/payload/rates, no dominant lockup, stable error counters, expected bus load. Confirm disconnect produces unavailable robot data within 100 ms.

procedure: In an instrumented test build, fill unused stack space with a pattern, exercise normal traffic, command floods and fault paths, then inspect the deepest overwrite.
initial_acceptance_target: Confirm adequate margin; the static 432-byte estimate is not a measured high-water mark. Preserve the test image hash.

procedure: Disconnect crystal only using a controlled test method, stall foreground in a test image, force watchdog reset, vary logic supply through PVD threshold.
initial_acceptance_target: Sensor enables fall; watchdog reset latches rails off; explicit recovery required. Do not short live MCU pins to simulate faults.

procedure: Send extended data ID 0 on a bench CAN network, including DLC 0 and 8.
initial_acceptance_target: Both rails off and latched; diagnostics continue; no automatic restart. Normal disabled robot state may retain sensor power.

procedure: On a dedicated test board, interrupt power at several points in a SET flash write, then reset.
initial_acceptance_target: Either old or new valid configuration loads; invalid records never enable an arbitrary rail/ID. Preserve captures and flash dumps.

procedure: With no external powered connections, apply −6 then −12 V through a conservative current limit for a short controlled test.
initial_acceptance_target: Protected rail remains unpowered; no heating or damage. Do not apply reverse voltage to sensor SIGNAL/POWER pins.

procedure: Board off; apply supported positive sensor signals through a current-limited source; measure 3V3 and terminal leakage.
initial_acceptance_target: No unintended startup/back-powering, no damage; establish measured leakage.

procedure: After basic operation, use a protected test fixture and actual harness at 6/12/18 V. Scope input current, VIN_PROT, Q1 VGS/VDS and rail overshoot.
initial_acceptance_target: Validate MOSFET/body-diode pulse stress, fuse survival and TVS energy. The passive model's ~113 A brief peak is not a qualified component stress result.

procedure: At maximum simultaneous load, soak at intended ambient, measure U1/U2/U3/U4/Q1/L1/C1 and connectors; then vibration/cable strain/EMI tests.
initial_acceptance_target: Junction and component temperatures remain below rated limits with margin. Establish a real operating-temperature rating; none has yet been qualified.
